record.paper_title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: When the graded tensor-product representations constructed by the braided Green-ansatz method for paraparticle algebras are decomposed into irreducible components, do they contain irreducible direct summands or submodules other than the known p-Fock-like modules?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be a paraparticle algebra (for instance, the parabosonic algebra $P_B$, the parafermionic algebra $P_F$, or one of the relative paraparticle algebras $P_{BF}$, $P_{FB}$), realized as a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded (or more generally $G$-graded) associative algebra whose generators satisfy trilinear relations of Green's type. Recall Green's ansatz: for each positive integer $p$, the $p$-Fock-like representation of $A$ is obtained by realizing the generators of $A$ as suitable sums of $p$ commuting/anticommuting copies of ordinary (anti)commutation generators acting on a $p$-fold tensor product of bosonic/fermionic Fock spaces, and then restricting to the cyclic submodule generated by the vacuum. In the braided setting, one replaces the ordinary tensor product by a braided tensor product determined by a graded braiding $\psi$ compatible with the grading group $G$, and the resulting construction (the braided Green ansatz) produces, for each $p\ge 1$, a graded $A$-module $V_p$ on a braided tensor power of a single-mode Fock representation.

Question: For the modules $V_p$ produced by the braided Green ansatz, decompose $V_p$ into irreducible $A$-submodules. Does this decomposition contain any irreducible direct summand or irreducible submodule that is not isomorphic to one of the known $p$-Fock-like irreducible representations of $A$? Equivalently, determine whether the family of $p$-Fock-like modules exhausts the irreducible constituents of every braided Green-ansatz tensor representation, or exhibit an irreducible constituent outside this family.
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was found. The braided Green-ansatz construction for paraparticle algebras and the structure of its decomposition into irreducibles is discussed in the literature on the Relative Parabose Set algebra and related paraparticle algebras, but the question of whether non-Fock-like irreducible constituents can occur appears to remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Ladder operators, Fock-spaces, irreducibility and group gradings for the Relative Parabose Set algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Infinite family of infinite-dimensional, non-equivalent irreducible Fock-like representations of the Relative Parabose Set algebra; ladder-operator action of the generators is computed explicitly.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the family of p-Fock-like irreducible representations against which any extra irreducible summand would be compared, but does not address the braided Green-ansatz decomposition question.
